content_of_post_to_answer: Do you think being a natural giver is a personality trait or a response to childhood trauma?
answer: Being a natural giver can come from both personality and adaptation, and the difference is often found in what happens when giving is not appreciated. Some people give because generosity feels aligned with who they are; others learned to give because being useful once felt like the safest way to receive love. I’ve explored this pattern more deeply on my profile, if you’re interested. The overlooked question is not “why do I give?” but “can I still feel worthy when I have nothing to offer?”
